paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend. You can't fix dead. Paul says we were dead in our trespasses and sins (Ephesians 2:1), and dead people don't pull themselves up, make a plan or hit snooze on the grave. So the good news starts with God, who is "rich in mercy," and "because of His great love for us" made us alive with Christ (Ephesians 2:4-5).

And that's why it's all grace, friend. Paul says, "For it is by grace you have been saved through faith, and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God, not by works, so that no one can boast" (Ephesians 2:8-9). I can't pay for a gift, and neither can you. You don't have to climb up to God and hope you did enough, because He has already raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him (Ephesians 2:6). Rest your whole weight on that!

But grace doesn't leave you sitting around, because we are "God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works" (Ephesians 2:10). Saved BY grace, made FOR good works. And God prepared those works in advance, so you're not inventing your purpose from scratch. Go on and walk into your day, baker, because God already warmed up the oven!
